_about: Public-domain Orville Dewey (1794-1882), Unitarian minister of the Church of the Messiah, New York, for the Word Hoard: Discourses on Various Subjects (1835), The Old World and the New (1836), Moral Views of Commerce, Society and Politics (1838), The Works of Orville Dewey (1844), Discourses on Human Nature, Human Life and the Nature of Religion (1847), Discourses and Reviews upon Questions in Controversial Theology (1852), The Laws of Human Progress (1852), Discourses on the Nature of Religion (1855), The Problem of Human Destiny (1864) and The Two Great Commandments (1876). John Dewey, on his own shelf, is another man. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 64 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
